browser.scope: All seventy recipient views, complete row/role/word counts, outcome contexts, mathematical rendering, no page overflow, and actual two-level lemma expansion.

scope: Node reconstructs typed family extraction and every finite binding, compiler/admission authority, selected proof-role markings, native acceptance reuse and recorded training updates. It rejects deliberate corruptions. The browser visits every recorded recipient view and expands the actual nested lemma derivation. Full candidate graphs, policy proposals and native tape computations are separately checked by the independent offline auditor.
